# The AI Loadout

> A free directory of AI tools ranked by use case ("loadouts"), plus a feed of new AI releases. 158 AI tools ranked S/A/B/C across 17 use-case loadouts (177 rankings, since some tools appear in more than one loadout). Last updated 2026-10-15.

## Pages
- [New AI releases](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/new/)
- [Weekly newsletter](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/newsletter/)
- [Tier badges](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/badge/)
- [Sponsor / advertise](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/sponsor/): Featured $49/mo, newsletter $25/issue or $75 for 4, homepage banner $99/mo

## Loadouts
- [Best AI tools for Coding](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/coding/): #1 Cursor — Best all-round AI code editor for shipping real apps fast
- [Best AI tools for AI Agents](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/agents/): #1 ChatGPT Agent — Best general-purpose agent for everyday tasks
- [Best AI tools for Chat](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/chat/): #1 Claude — Best for writing, coding and long documents
- [Best AI tools for Image](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/image/): #1 Midjourney — Best pure image quality and style
- [Best AI tools for Video](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/video/): #1 Veo (Google Flow) — Best realism with native audio
- [Best AI tools for Voice](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/voice/): #1 ElevenLabs — Best voices, cloning and dubbing
- [Best AI tools for Writing](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/writing/): #1 Claude — Best natural-sounding long-form writing
- [Best AI tools for Research](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/research/): #1 Perplexity — Best answer engine with sources
- [Best AI tools for Game Dev](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/game-dev/): #1 Rosebud AI — Best for vibe coding browser games from prompts
- [Best AI tools for Productivity](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/productivity/): #1 Granola — Best AI meeting notes without a bot joining
- [Best AI tools for Crypto](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/crypto-finance/): #1 Perplexity Finance — Best for quick, sourced answers on stocks and markets
- [Best AI tools for 3D](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/3d/): #1 Meshy — Best all-round text/image to 3D
- [Best AI tools for Music](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/music/): #1 Suno — Best for full songs with vocals from a prompt
- [Best AI tools for Education](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/education/): #1 NotebookLM — Best for studying your own notes and sources
- [Best AI tools for Streamers](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/creators/): #1 OpusClip — Best for turning long videos into viral shorts
- [Best AI tools for Open-Source & Local Models](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/local-models/): #1 Ollama — Best one-command way to run models locally
- [Best AI tools for AI in Games](https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/ai-in-games/): #1 Inworld AI — Best for AI NPC characters and voices
